name: EWM
summary: EWM (Elliott Wave Markup) is an interactive charting utility for manual Elliott Wave analysis and annotation on MetaTrader 5. It provides tools for drawing, dragging, and managing wave labels, pitchforks (Andrews), and performing automated wave pattern recognition via the EWA module, but does not open trades on its own.
summary_zh: EWM（艾略特波浪标记）是一个用于在MetaTrader 5图表上进行手动艾略特波浪分析和标注的交互式工具。它提供了绘制、拖拽和管理波浪标签、安德鲁音叉以及通过EWA模块进行自动波浪形态识别的功能，但本身不进行任何自动交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非自动交易策略，而是一个艾略特波浪分析辅助工具。它由三个核心模块组成：EWM模块负责波浪标记的绘制、拖拽、层级切换和删除管理；EWA模块负责自动波浪分析和变体选择；P模块负责安德鲁音叉的绘制与更新。用户可以通过键盘快捷键在波浪层级间导航（上/下/前/后），启动左侧或右侧的自动波浪分析，并在多个分析变体间切换。入场和出场条件完全由用户根据波浪分析结果自行判断，EA本身不包含任何仓位管理或资金管理逻辑。工具还支持水平线、价格标签、垂直线等辅助标注的显示与隐藏，以及图表模板的复制功能。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an automated trading strategy but an interactive Elliott Wave analysis and annotation tool. It consists of three core modules: the EWM module handles wave label drawing, dragging, level navigation, and deletion; the EWA module performs automated wave pattern recognition and variant selection; the P module manages Andrews pitchfork drawing and updating. Users can navigate between wave levels via keyboard shortcuts (up/down/prev/next), initiate left or right-side automated wave analysis, and cycle through multiple analysis variants. Entry and exit conditions are entirely determined by the user based on their wave analysis interpretation—the EA contains no position sizing or money management logic whatsoever. The tool also supports showing/hiding auxiliary annotations such as horizontal lines, price labels, vertical lines, and provides a chart template copy function.

pros: 提供完整的艾略特波浪手动标注和自动分析功能，适合波浪理论实践者
支持丰富的键盘快捷键操作，波浪层级导航和变体切换效率高
集成安德鲁音叉工具，提供多维度的技术分析辅助
支持图表模板复制功能，便于在不同图表间复用分析配置
支持对象拖拽和删除事件响应，交互体验流畅
pros_en: Provides comprehensive Elliott Wave manual annotation and automated analysis, ideal for wave theory practitioners
Rich keyboard shortcut support enables efficient wave level navigation and variant switching
Integrated Andrews pitchfork tool offers multi-dimensional technical analysis assistance
Chart template copy feature facilitates reusing analysis configurations across different charts
Responsive to object drag and delete events, delivering a smooth interactive experience
cons: 不包含任何自动交易逻辑，用户需完全依赖自身判断进行交易决策
代码中所有参数均为硬编码常量，无法通过EA输入参数界面进行自定义配置
缺乏错误处理机制，如对象操作失败、模板保存/加载异常等均未处理
依赖外部头文件库（ewa.mqh, ewm.mqh, p.mqh, parser.mqh），代码可读性和可维护性受限
无用户文档或内置帮助提示，新用户学习成本高
cons_en: Contains no automated trading logic—users must rely entirely on their own judgment for trade decisions
All parameters are hardcoded constants with no configurable EA input parameters interface
Lacks error handling for object operation failures, template save/load exceptions, etc.
Heavy dependency on external header libraries (ewa.mqh, ewm.mqh, p.mqh, parser.mqh) limits code readability and maintainability
No user documentation or built-in help hints, resulting in a steep learning curve for new users
improvements: 将键盘快捷键映射改为可配置的EA输入参数，提升用户自定义灵活性
添加操作提示面板或工具提示，降低新用户的学习门槛
增加对象操作和模板操作的错误处理与状态反馈
improvements_en: Convert keyboard shortcut mappings to configurable EA input parameters for greater customization flexibility
Add an operation hint panel or tooltips to lower the learning threshold for new users
Implement error handling and status feedback for object operations and template operations

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，不存在资金风险
自动波浪分析结果仅作为参考，不直接触发交易，但用户若盲目依赖分析结果可能导致主观判断失误
risk_points_en: The EA does not execute any trading operations, posing no financial risk
Automated wave analysis results serve as reference only and do not trigger trades, but users relying blindly on analysis may make poor subjective judgments

It provides tools for drawing, dragging, and managing wave labels, pitchforks (Andrews), and performing automated wave pattern recognition via the EWA module, but does not open trades on its own.
